color.description: The color of the wheel when the value is within this range.

label.description:
A string to be displayed when the value is within this range.
If no string is specified, the value will be displayed.

min.description: The minimum value (inclusive) required to display this color.

max.description: The maximum value (exclusive) that must not be met or exceeded to display this color.

title: Type containing configurations for a color threshold for a color wheel custom grid cell.
name: UiSdlColorWheelDataGridConditionalColorSetting
